Senses.Explanation: Seated consultation is a scheduled communal monastery session in which the assembly sits and receives instruction. The Baizhang and auxiliary monastic codes list seated consultation among regulated communal events alongside seated discipline, private inquiry, meals, and assemblies. Juyun Chuiwan Guangzhen calls it a session and explains the work demanded during and beyond the session in two distinct records. The institutional sense differs from simply sitting while consulting a text or person; only witnesses that name the monastic session or its explicit session support this entry.
